title: cerastium fontanum var. holosteoides
intro: Cerastium fontanum var. holosteoides, commonly known as mouse-ear chickweed, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, inflammation, and skin problems, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of mouse-ear chickweed include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and calm digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
